_: Multi-stage quest demo. The quest 'A Forged Errand' has 3 stages (10 start, 20 mid, 30 complete) each writing a JOURNAL log entry; stage 30 carries completeQuest so the quest closes. Two objectives display/complete as the stages set: obj 10 shows at stage 10 and completes at stage 20; obj 20 shows at stage 20 and completes at stage 30. A dialogue line on Joren advances the quest from stage 10 to stage 20 (setStage). CRITICAL (It.36, root-caused in-game): a quest needs a journal-visible TYPE (DNAM) or it never shows — type=None (Mutagen default) is a background/controller quest, so its log entries don't surface and `setstage` does nothing on screen. This quest has journal content (objectives + stage log text) so the build now defaults its `type` to SideQuest; set `type` explicitly (None|Misc|SideQuest|MainQuest|...) to override. With a visible type the STAGE LOG ENTRIES show in the journal on `setstage` with NO Papyrus needed (pure record data). What still needs the generated Papyrus fragment scaffolds (emitted by `package` under Scripts/Source, compiled + bound in the Creation Kit): making OBJECTIVES display/complete on stage-set (SetObjectiveDisplayed/Completed) and the dialogue line SET the stage. Dialogue, as always, only registers on a game LOAD (or save+reload on an existing save; build auto-considerations apply).

npcs.name: Joren the Forged
npcs.greeting: You there. I have an errand, if you're willing.

stages.logEntry: Joren has asked me to retrieve his lost hammer from the river.
I told Joren I would help. Time to search the riverbank.
I returned the hammer to Joren. The errand is done.

dialogue._: Picking this line advances the quest to stage 20 (setStage). The build wires the INFO + emits MF_TIF_MF_AgreeToHelp.psc (GetOwningQuest().SetStage(20)) on `package` for CK binding.
responses: Good. Last I saw it, it slipped into the shallows by the mill.
Bring it back and I'll see you rewarded.

placements._: Joren in the Sleeping Giant Inn common room (in-room coord, on navmesh).
